name: Electronic Specialties of Ct
old_description: Exceptional Manufacturer of Printed Circuit Board Assembly Solutions
about:
Electronic Specialties of Connecticut, Inc. (ESOCI) operates from a 14,500-square-foot climate-controlled facility in Hamden, Connecticut. The company was established in 1981 by Rich Dumont. In 2012, Duc Nguyen became the sole owner after purchasing the business with a partner.

ESOCI provides printed circuit board assembly services covering through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed-technology processes. The shop handles prototype builds—either by hand or on a dedicated prototype line—through full production runs, with high-speed Juki placement lines capable of 60,000 components per hour. It offers both turnkey and consigned-material programs, supported by an MRP system, and adds value through box-build unit assembly, cable and harness integration, and design services including circuit layout. The facility also houses aqueous cleaning, wave soldering, and automated optical and X-ray inspection equipment.

The company serves original equipment manufacturers and electronics developers across sectors that require PCB assembly, though specific industry verticals are not detailed in its public materials. Customers range from prototype-stage innovators to established firms needing full-scale production.

ESOCI states its mission is to exceed customer expectations for quality, service, technology, and cost while maintaining a safe, growth-oriented workplace. Its vision emphasizes satisfying every customer need with the highest quality circuit board assembly service.

name: Element Materials Technology Wilmington (Formerly SL Pharma Labs Inc. )
old_description: It was in the late 20th century (1997) that SL Pharma Labs started providing its clients with its high-quality service. On the one hand, we aimed at offering a top-quality pharmaceutical product. On the other one, we ensured the testing of topical, liquid, and parenteral drugs. The entire process covered several development directions (formulation, analytical, microbiological) along with clinical manufacturing in the early stages.
about:
Element Materials Technology Wilmington, formerly SL Pharma Labs Inc., was founded in 1997 in Wilmington, Delaware. The company began by providing high-quality pharmaceutical testing services for topical, liquid, and parenteral drugs, covering formulation, analytical, and microbiological development alongside early-stage clinical manufacturing.

Today the firm operates as a contract development and manufacturing organization offering a full suite of CMC services. Its capabilities span pre-formulation and formulation development, analytical and microbiological development with quality control testing, parenteral and topical product development and clinical manufacturing, ICH stability testing, technical transfers, and regulatory documentation support for ANDA, NDA, and IND submissions. The company serves clients ranging from start-ups to multinational corporations across the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

Its customer base includes both large and small organizations, with noted collaborations involving My Canadian Pharmacy and Charles W. Newhall of Pharmoscorp.com. The company focuses on technology transfer to support commercial production stages for U.S. and Canadian pharmaceutical clients.

SL Pharma Labs distinguishes itself through five stated pillars: experienced staff with deep industry knowledge, a customized adaptive approach, reliability in meeting deadlines and budgets, end-to-end project collaboration, and continuous GMP-compliance tracking throughout the product lifecycle.

name: Elevate Packaging
old_description: Elevate Packaging is the leading provider of compostable packaging and labels. Our exclusive PURE Labels™ are the first and only certified compostable label in North America. With our bags, pouches, and labels, we offer a complete one-stop compostable packaging solution for sustainable business.
about:
Elevate Packaging is based in Chicago, Illinois. Founded in 2000 by Rich Cohen after a 1999 sabbatical during which he discovered tree-free papers made from invasive plant species, Cohen, a former corporate strategist and computer scientist at a Fortune 500 company, launched the venture to address plastic pollution he witnessed while trail running and climbing.

The company designs and produces a full line of compostable packaging, including stand-up pouches, flat pouches, cellophane bags, coffee bags, poly mailers, pressure-sensitive labels (PURE Labels™), packaging tape, and gloves. Products are sold in stock sizes (e.g., 100-count packs, 1,000-label rolls) and as custom-printed orders with vivid full-color graphics. Elevate also operates a take-back program with the Compost Stewardship Institute to collect and compost used packaging.

Customers span natural and organic food brands, institutional food service, coffee and tea roasters, cannabis producers, apparel and body-care companies, e-commerce retailers, and restaurants. The company serves businesses of all sizes seeking to replace petroleum-based plastics with certified compostable alternatives.

Elevate was founded on the mission “Eliminate Plastic Waste and Create a Healthy Planet.” The company positions itself as environmentalists first, emphasizing that its products meet ASTM D6400 and BPI certification standards, and that its take-back program ensures packaging actually gets composted, closing the loop in a circular economy.

name: Elevation Foods
old_description: Great food is our reputation. We partner with leading retailers and operators to bring exceptional food concepts to life. We are a passionate team of experts in culinary, R&D, marketing, manufacturing, and sourcing with a track record of innovative food ideas that delight customers, drive growth, and elevate brands.
about:
Elevation Foods operates from Knoxville, Tennessee, with a second manufacturing facility in Danvers, Massachusetts. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders. It describes itself as a team of food-passionate, highly-collaborative, entrepreneurial business leaders combining a decades-long track record of food marketing and manufacturing with culinary, chef-created food concepts.

The company produces savory baked goods such as quiches and chicken pot pies, dips and spreads, deli salads, and ready-to-eat sous vide potatoes. Its manufacturing capabilities include kettle cooking, baking, mixing, and filling for both refrigerated and frozen products, with packaging formats ranging from single-serve retail to bulk foodservice sizes. Two redundant facilities in Knoxville and Danvers provide national and regional supply coverage.

Elevation Foods serves retail and foodservice channels, working with grocery and club retailers, as well as foodservice operators such as delis, sandwich bars, and hot bars. The company offers contract manufacturing and private label services, developing custom products for brands and retailers across its core categories.

The company emphasizes food safety and consistency, noting daily USDA inspection, SQF certification, HACCP compliance, and third-party audits. Its stated differentiation lies in culinary-inspired concepts that challenge traditional prepared food paradigms, delivered through collaborative R&D and culinary teams that scale customer recipes without compromise.

name: Elite Medical Care
old_description: Since 2016, Elite Medical Care has been a family-owned, full-service durable medical equipment (DME) provider. We operate across all of Arkansas and half of Mississippi. We specialize in comprehensive respiratory therapy, offering equipment such as invasive and noninvasive ventilators, Trilogy machines for COPD, tracheostomy care, oxygen systems, and CPAPs/BiPAPs.
about:
Elite Medical Care was founded in 2016 in Mabelvale, Arkansas, as a family-owned, full-service durable medical equipment provider. The company serves all of Arkansas and roughly half of Mississippi from its base in the Little Rock metro area.

The firm supplies a range of respiratory therapy equipment, including invasive and noninvasive ventilators, Trilogy machines for COPD management, tracheostomy care supplies, oxygen systems, and CPAP/BiPAP devices. It also provides hospital beds and wheelchairs. A team of licensed respiratory therapists conducts home setup, patient education, and ongoing device management, and the company offers same-day delivery for urgent needs.

Customers include home-health patients, families, and institutional partners such as nursing centers and hospice organizations. Testimonials on the company's site reference collaborations with a local nursing center (Bethany Stayton, LPN), a hospice administrator (Heather Goodson, RN), and a community health provider (Norma Baker, CHA).

The company states that its locally rooted, family-focused staff and continuous clinical training distinguish its service model.

name: Elite Printing and Packaging, Inc
old_description: At Elite, we blend craftsmanship, efficiency, and uncompromising attention to detail to help brands scale with confidence. Every pouch, label, and shipment that leaves our facility reflects your best. As a tight-knit, experienced team, we provide clear communication, flexible solutions, and partnership you can trust—treating your business like our own.
about:
Based in Hazelwood, Missouri, Elite Printing and Packaging is a family-owned business that operates as a single-source partner for custom printing, packaging, co-packing, and fulfillment. The company serves brands across the St. Louis region and beyond from its facility in the St. Louis metro area.

Elite produces flexible packaging using digital and rotogravure presses, creating rollstock, labels, shrink sleeves, tamper bands, retail cartons, and point-of-sale materials. Its packaging line includes stand-up, gusseted, and flat pouches, pillow packs, sachets, jars, tubes, and canisters, with eco-friendly options such as recyclable, compostable, matte, and metallic finishes. Co-packing capabilities cover vertical form-fill-seal (VFFS) pouching for treats, snacks, and powders, flow-wrapped pillow packs, jar and tube filling, and kitting, labeling, and assembly. Fulfillment services span e-commerce and retail order processing, pick-and-pack, POS assembly, lot tracking, inventory management, and LTL/FTL shipping with daily UPS and FedEx pickups. The company handles runs from small batches to high-volume production.

Elite's customer base centers on the food sector, particularly pet food and human food brands. The company cites experience with pet treats, snacks, powders, and specialty food products, and works with brands launching new items, preparing for retail distribution, or seeking to streamline their supply chain.

The company emphasizes its all-in-one model, traceable lot control with quality assurance at every step, fast turnaround times, flexible order minimums, and a family-owned, detail-driven culture as its primary differentiators.

name: Elite Spice Inc
old_description: is an industry leading spice importer and custom manufacturer offering an extensive line of spices, seasonings and specialty food ingredients.  American owned and operated, with six separate state-of-the-art facilities on the East and West coasts, Elite’s focus on food safety is uncompromising.  With a reputation for exceptional quality, superior R&D capabilities, experienced technical support and outstanding customer service, Elite Spice is prepared to meet the needs of all segments of the commercial food industry.
about:
Elite Spice Inc., founded in 1988, is a privately-held, American-owned spice importer and custom manufacturer headquartered in Sparks, Nevada. The company operates six facilities across the East and West coasts, with a focus on food safety and purity.

The company supplies an extensive line of spices, herbs, seasonings, capsicums, onion and garlic, dehydrated fruits and vegetables, and specialty food ingredients. Its manufacturing operations include cleaning, milling, custom blending, packaging, and validated microbial reduction and pathogen elimination systems, all controlled in-house. A culinary innovation center and multiple R&D laboratories support product development.

Elite Spice serves all segments of the commercial food industry, providing ingredients for some of the world’s most popular food brands. Its customer base includes food manufacturers and processors seeking custom blends and technical support.

The company differentiates itself through its “Processed in the USA” commitment, maintaining direct control over the entire manufacturing process from raw material sourcing to finished goods. Its quality assurance laboratories conduct a wide range of tests to ensure compliance with U.S. federal regulations and food safety laws.

name: Ellerbuilt Woodworks
old_description: Driven by a deep respect for the creative process and an unwavering commitment to doing what is right, Ellerbuilt was founded on a simple, powerful idea: if you are going to spend your life creating, you should pour everything you have into it. Every table, every project, every piece is the result of patience, purpose, and an artist’s relentless pursuit of excellence — even when no one is watching.
about:
Ellerbuilt Woodworks operates from Carson City, Nevada, where founder Brandon Eller established the shop as an expression of a lifelong dedication to woodworking. Eller traces his craft to childhood experiences — fixing and refinishing pieces by age ten — and a deep admiration for Japanese joinery traditions. The business remains owner‑operated, with Eller personally overseeing design, construction, and finishing of every commission.

The company produces custom cabinetry and handcrafted furniture for residential spaces. Its portfolio spans kitchen and bathroom cabinets, built‑ins, shelving, wall units, media cabinets, home‑office furniture (including partner and standing desks), bedroom pieces such as headboards, dressers, and bunk beds, as well as kitchen islands, custom pantries, eat‑in tables, bar cabinets, and home‑theater millwork. Work combines traditional hand‑tool joinery with modern machining and finishing techniques, using conversion varnish, catalyzed lacquer, and UV‑cured finishes. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Ellerbuilt serves homeowners, interior designers, and residential contractors seeking made‑to‑measure woodwork. Projects are typically commissioned for kitchens, baths, home offices, bedrooms, and entertainment areas. The shop works with a broad palette of domestic and exotic hardwoods — oak, maple, cherry, walnut, redwood, cedar, and other specialty species — selected during a consultation process that matches material to the project’s aesthetic and durability requirements.

Eller positions the business on an uncompromising standard of craftsmanship: each piece is built to heirloom quality, with meticulous attention to detail and a deliberate, patient process. The founder’s philosophy — "if something is easy to do, it’s not worth doing" — drives a practice that favors the more difficult path when it yields a better result, aiming to create objects that endure across generations.

name: Ellis Fabrics
old_description: Ellis Fabrics in Bentonville, Arkansas, offers a wide selection of quality, affordable upholstery and home décor fabrics and trims, as well as customer service that can’t be beat. We encourage you to come in, browse, and ask any questions you may have. We love to talk with our customers about their projects!
about:
Ellis Fabrics operates in Bentonville, Arkansas, as the retail arm of Joe Ellis Upholstery. Joe Ellis began upholstering in 2002, working with independent shops across Arkansas and Louisiana. He opened Joe Ellis Upholstery in 2008, and the business grew to a larger space within five years. In 2013, Ellis and his mother, Cheryl, added a fabric store to answer customers' frequent question about where to buy materials. The company remains privately owned by Ellis.

The business runs two workrooms staffed by nine full-time professionals and additional part-time help. They produce custom upholstery for residential, commercial, and specialty projects, handling everything from frame repair to final fabric application. The fabric store stocks a wide range of upholstery and home décor fabrics, trims, designer lines, real and faux leather, and outdoor and specialty materials, with special-order capability. A designer is on site to assist with selection and durability questions.

Clients span residential homeowners, hospitality venues (restaurants, bars, hotels, museums), medical and fitness facilities, and RV/motorhome owners. Notable customers include the Roark Group (design and fabrication), Onyx Coffee Lab (hospitality), Laura's Draperies & Blinds (window treatments), and various interior designers across Arkansas, Oklahoma, and Missouri.

The company emphasizes a full-service experience from consultation through delivery, offering pick-up and delivery and promoting the motto "If you can dream it, we can upholster it." Their differentiation rests on in-house design guidance, a broad fabric inventory, and the ability to handle unique, tight-timeline projects.
